mapper.select: SELECT * FROM loan_ledger WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_ledger ( loan_no, customer_id, linked_account_id, requested_amount, requested_period, is_credit_info_agreed, is_product_terms_agreed, is_document_collected, applied_credit_score, applied_dsr, interest_rate, reject_reason, reviewed_at, status ) VALUES ( #{loanNo}, #{customerId}, #{linkedAccountId}, #{requestedAmount}, #{requestedPeriod}, #{isCreditInfoAgreed}, #{isProductTermsAgreed}, #{isDocumentCollected}, #{appliedCreditScore}, #{appliedDsr}, #{interestRate}, #{rejectReason}, #{reviewedAt}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_ledger SET product_id = #{productId}, loan_amount = #{loanAmount}, current_loan_balance = #{loanAmount}, interest_rate = #{interestRate}, repayment_type = #{repaymentType}, repayment_period = #{repaymentPeriod}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE loan_no = #{loanNo}
